method: CPU joint diagnostic, not WGSL execution/readback, rendered pixels, image contrast, sharpness or photographic acceptance. Exactly one baseline256³/128³ volume. Filtered16³ half-float flow and flow.a, camera micro erosion, clear day left sun, time60/wind.55, mature growth, no gust/dispersion/rain/flash. Target and near radius pinned independently of support bounds, no ordinary surface probe. Five reference UV rays use1.5/3/6m midpoint quadrature; full positive opacity contributions retained at3m. Additional9x9 UV nodes in [.35,.65]^2 use3m summaries, not a rendered image. Weight=T_before*(1-exp(-rho*extinction*ds)), cutoff.006; source cache sampled at the unwarped filtered local coordinate, retaining existing co-deformed static-light approximation. Luminance before aerial/tone. Floor is ambientColor*.18 plus [.028,.032,.04]; ambient/multiple totals include their floor and are not added to floor again. Residuals subtract a segment-length-weighted local linear fit over stated physical window widths, then use opacity-weighted RMS/correlation; these windows are detrending filters, not exact Fourier bands. High raw Pearson alone can arise from shared depth trends. Useful fine coupling requires nonnegligible residual amplitudes as well as stable correlation/convergence; correlations are not causal, do not measure projected texture contrast, and do not imply photographic quality. Metre-scale erosion may alias at3/6m: use1.5m comparison without assuming complete resolution.
